subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should `recordOutboundMessageIdentity` and `isRecentOutboundMessageIdentity` remain a supported public plugin-SDK contract for all channel plugins, with the proposed closed ownership and 30-second retention model?
rationale: The implementation moves a Discord-specific behavior into a public, generic plugin seam; code review can assess mechanics, but maintainers must choose the permanent external contract and lifecycle semantics.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
options.body: Accept the core-owned identity registry as the supported cross-channel API after real behavior proof confirms the Discord and Slack paths.

options.title: Keep the seam internal to Discord
options.body: Limit the registry to the Discord owner boundary if a reusable external plugin contract is not intended.

options.title: Define a narrower plugin contract
options.body: Revise the exported API and documentation before merge if maintainers want different identity, retention, or lifecycle ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam
recommendation.body: Accept the core-owned identity registry as the supported cross-channel API after real behavior proof confirms the Discord and Slack paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal and its cross-surface contract documentation are concentrated in this contributor’s current branch, making them the closest available routing candidate.
